capture_mode: deterministic hidden in-app replay through canvas_input
cursor_cue: A synthetic cursor ring shows SELECT over the stroke, ERASE during the partial erase, and ORBIT during camera navigation; a persistent banner discloses no pressure data.

encoding.gif: In-app screenshot frames downscaled to 640x360; image GIF encoder without a loop extension (plays once); 10 fps; <=5 MiB.
encoding.mp4: Captured full-viewport RGBA frames; Blender H.264 fallback; 10 fps; repeated frame holds preserve the 6s duration.
encoding.poster: Selected full-resolution action frame encoded as PNG.

input_note: The fixture stroke is created through the production pointer-action handler and its appearance edit through the production selection handler. Captured PenSample input uses pressure=None and no tilt; no tablet pressure or latency was measured.
license_or_provenance: Procedurally generated from an empty Sketch3D document by the production pointer-action handler; no external artwork or assets.

poster.alt: Two editable orange fragments after a partial erase, with the synthetic-input disclosure.

review.notes: Synthetic edit-erase replay. Selection and appearance editing run through production handlers during capture, followed by a partial erase, undo, and orbit. Reviewed GIF key frames at 0/10/20/30/40/50, checked selected full-resolution posters, compared all VTT cues with action checkpoints, and validated VTT order/duration. Confirmed GIFs have no loop extension and scanned manifests/media for private paths. Full native-resolution motion/readability and rendered README-surface review remain pending.

shot_steps: Create an editable stroke through the production pointer-action handler and change its appearance through the selection editor handler.
Drag the partial eraser through the stroke using synthetic input through canvas_input.
Undo restores the edited source stroke; a short orbit reveals the result.
